notes.title: The Journey of Tower of Madness – Behind the Scenes!
notes.content:
The launch of Tower of Madness has been incredible. Getting to see players and content creators react to the game has been really fun! I’m grateful to everyone who gave it a chance. 

To share more about the journey, I’ve put together a video documenting the development and launch of the game. If you’re curious about the behind-the-scenes process, check it out here:

[previewyoutube=-nZjrw5vJk4;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you all for your support! Let me know what you think of the video, and feel free to share your own experiences with Tower of Madness!

notes.title: Pathing, Controller, and Language Improvements
notes.content:
Some general improvements to make the AI feel more fair and the final level of the game more intuitive to understand. Also fixed some minor issues, the end game achievements and added some translations. Full list of changes: 

[list]
[*]Improved pathing on two monsters in the game to prevent them from clipping through walls unfairly. 
[*]Added translations for the escape menu buttons. 
[*]Added translations for the "Move Forward" prompt. 
[*]Fixed the first floors song not being effected by the volume sliders. 
[*]Fixed controller not being able to make the player sprint. 
[*]Fixed the achievements relating to the different endings of the game. 
[/list]

notes.title: Delayed Release to Oct. 26th
notes.content:
Tower of Madness will be delayed by one day, to [i]October 26th, 2024[/i]. We appreciate the patience and understanding of the community as we put the final touches on this terrifying and immersive experience.

Tower of Madness invites players to confront their fears in a linear, narrative-driven horror adventure. With three possible endings based on player choices, five monsters designed to scare even the bravest of players, and an average playtime of 35 minutes, the game promises a gripping, unsettling journey into the unknown.

For the completionists, there are 17 Steam achievements to unlock, as well as 10 collectible notes scattered throughout the game that provide deeper insights into the mysterious and haunting story.

While the delay is brief, the extra time will ensure the best possible experience for all players. J6 Games is committed to delivering a polished, unforgettable horror experience, and we can't wait for players to uncover the secrets of the Tower of Madness. The game will have steam cloud saving, allowing players to pick up where they left off across devices.
